# Distributed_Intelligent_Manufacturing

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A manufacturing paradigm that decentralizes production across networked, intelligent, and on-site facilities to enhance resilience and adaptability. Aligns with TCC/iNEST goals of distributed, low-latency, and adaptive computing architectures for real-time control and edge processing.
